long_biography.plain_text:
Galápagos tourism provided the setting for Schreyer Goerlitz's operating career. A locally born seaman and marine engineer, he joined a specialist Ecuador tour business after its founding generation and assumed responsibility for island voyages. Alongside that operational role, he has held ownership and management positions in Puerto Ayora passenger-tour businesses.

Industry governance gave the work a public dimension. He led the association representing Galápagos tourist-vessel operators during a constitutional dispute over employment and operating rules, then joined the provincial tourism chamber's board. That progression—from technical work at sea to company management and trade representation—places him within the archipelago's long-running effort to balance visitor access, local employment and conservation.
